rail.name: DB InfraGO infrastructure data
rail.coverage: DB InfraGO railway routes in Germany
rail.caveat: Route geometry is simplified for browser rendering.

ports.name: Eurostat GISCO ports
ports.coverage: German ports in the GISCO world ports layer
ports.caveat: Official reference geometry; the ports release is not a live operations feed.

airports.name: Eurostat GISCO airports
airports.coverage: German airport reference points from GISCO Airports 2024
airports.caveat: Reference geography, not live flight operations.

industry.name: European Industrial Emissions Portal
industry.coverage: Large German industrial sites reported under IED/E-PRTR
industry.caveat: Reporting thresholds exclude smaller facilities; reporting years vary by site.

gas.name: SciGRID_gas IGGIELGNC-3
gas.coverage: Open model of gas pipelines, storage, LNG, and border points
gas.caveat: Research network model, not a live operational or safety map.

energy.name: MaStR bulk electricity units
energy.coverage: Largest coordinate-backed German electricity units by technology
energy.caveat: Browser layer is capacity-filtered and does not include every small rooftop/storage unit.

hydrogen_context.name: Approved German hydrogen core network
hydrogen_context.map_note: The official map is schematic. Exact routes are decided in later planning and permitting, so InfraAtlas does not draw false-precision line geometry.
